messages:
anna-partnerships: Heads-up 9: planning cross-cloud marketplace launch (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need final checklist for each marketplace by EOD Monday so marketing can prepare asset bundles. Key asks: SKU naming convention, export-control / data residency flags, trial entitlements, and packaging format (AMI vs container vs VM image).

karen-legal: I'll compile export-control and sanctions language. Quick confirm: will the marketplace listing allow customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) or only platform-managed? That affects privacy attachment.

jess-product: For initial GA let's do platform-managed keys only to avoid KMS integration overhead. We can add BYOK as a follow-up feature doc. SKU pattern: redwood:d:region:edition (e.g., redwood:d:us-west-2:standard). Keep it short so cloud portals accept it.

leo-aws-eng: For AWS we should provide either an AMI (for marketplace AMI flows) or an ECS/ECR container listing for container-based offers. Metering for SaaS/AMI differsif using metering, we need a SaaS metering endpoint or AWS MeterUsage integration. Also note AWS requires the seller to register as a vendor and provide bank details in the portal.

maria-azure-eng: Azure wants a VHD or marketplace VM image plus a legal offer ID. For managed images (ACRs) we need publisher verification. Also: region availability matrix is required per offer.

emily-marketing: Marketing checklist: 1) 1x 80x80 logo PNG, 2) 1x 1024x512 hero image, 3) 2-line and 1-paragraph product blurb, 4) minimum 3 screenshots (console, quickstart, billing). Need all by Tue EOD to meet the portal review window.

marketplace-integ-bot: FYI: AWS vendor registration typically takes 2-4 business days. Submit assets and contract attachments early to avoid queue. Internal doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/marketplace/quickstart.

karen-legal: Re export control: implement a checkbox in the listing for restricted countries; I'll supply copy: "This software is subject to U.S. export control laws; certain countries and end-users may be restricted." Also preparing privacy/data processing addendum template (DPA) for EU customers.

jess-product: Packaging: single release tarball containing: install.sh, quickstart.md, license.txt, telemetry-off flag, and a small sample config to run in a single node. For container offers, we also include a Helm sample.

leo-aws-eng: Sharing minimal IAM policy for marketplace listing to call our metering webhook (placeholder values):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["marketplace:MeterUsage","sts:AssumeRole"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-marketplace-role"
    }
  ]
}
```

maria-azure-eng: Azure note: if we publish through Azure Marketplace SaaS offers, we must expose a commerce endpoint to handle 3rd party metering or license validation. Also need to register support contact and incident SLA in the offer metadata.

emily-marketing: We should decide the short blurb now so I can localize. Suggest: "Redwood Dedicated: high-throughput, cost-conscious LLM inference for self-hosted and managed deployments." Anyone object?

karen-legal: That copy is fine. Also confirm we will not include pricing numbers in the listing for some regions due to currency/legal constraints?

jess-product: We'll include unit pricing tiers (per vGPU-hour, per-embedding block) where marketplaces allow it; else link to our pricing page.

anna-partnerships: Action items: Karen to upload legal copy + DPA by Monday AM; Leo and Maria to drop AMI/VHD/container URIs and region matrix by Monday noon; Jess to upload packaging tarball and SKU map; Emily to prepare imagery and blurb. I'll assemble and start vendor registration flows.

marketplace-integ-bot: Task created: marketplace-assets-1779239999 assigned to anna-partnerships, due in 5 days.

leo-aws-eng: I'll also add a note about automated health-check endpoints for the AMI ( /healthz ) so cloud reviewers pass validations.

emily-marketing: Got it. Will ping localization for EN/FR/DE.

karen-legal: Uploaded initial DPA draft: https://internal.redwood/legal/dpa-marketplace-draft-v1.docx. Please review by EOD.

jess-product: Tarball uploaded to s3://redwood-marketplace/q4/packaging-ga-v1.tar.gz with README and quickstart.

anna-partnerships: Thank you all. We'll reconvene if portal asks for changes after submission. If anyone gets blocked by vendor verification ping me directly. :sparkles:
